name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 29 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-08-19, at wavelengths from 1.40 to 4.91 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
